pages.howIntro: The Host Club organises experiences designed to meet new people, without you having to organise anything.
pages.safetyText: Public places and verified partners, a code of conduct accepted by every member, only useful details (first name, interests) shared with your group, and you can report any behaviour after each experience.
pages.aboutText: We believe people connect better around a table, a yoga mat or a puzzle than through a screen. The Host Club was born in Casablanca to help everyone widen their circle, discover their city and break their routine.
pages.contactText: A question, a partnership idea or a place you'd like us to discover? Write to us.
pages.contactDemo: The contact form is enabled on the live site. Meanwhile, write to us by email.
pages.legalDraft: Document being drafted with our legal advisers (Law 09-08 and CNDP requirements). It will be published before bookings open.

pages.faqMore: More answers in the help centre

faq.a1: No. The Host Club brings people together around experiences to make new friends and widen their circle.
faq.q2: Can I come on my own?
faq.a2: Yes, that's the whole idea: most members book alone. We put the tables and teams together.
faq.a3: Based on the languages you speak, your interests, age ranges and the balance of the group, avoiding always seating the same people together. Our team approves every group.
faq.a4: Yes, free of charge up to 48 hours before the experience. After that, the spot is not refunded. If we cancel, you get a full refund.
faq.q5: How old do I need to be?
faq.a5: The Host Club is for people aged 18 and over.
faq.a6: Your spot and all the organising: the venue, the group, the welcome. What is included on site (menu, drinks, equipment, class) is detailed on each experience page, under “Included”.
faq.a7: Each experience lists its languages (French, Darija, Arabic, English…). The languages in your profile help us put together groups where everyone can join the conversation.
faq.q8: I have a dietary requirement or an allergy: what should I do?
faq.a8: Write to us as soon as you book (Contact page): we check with the partner venue and suggest a solution, or another experience if it isn't possible. Have a look at the menu shown on the page.
faq.a9: For an annual price, you get the member price on experiences (shown next to the public price) and, depending on the plan, early access to new dates and members-only experiences. It lasts 12 months, with no automatic renewal.
faq.a10: You can leave at any time. Talk to the venue staff or our team, and report any inappropriate behaviour: we handle every report. All our experiences take place in public venues. See the Safety page.

aboutPage.founderRole: Founder and host of The Host Club
aboutPage.founderP1: After ten years in France, Aya came back to Casablanca with a simple wish: to find her place at home again, among people who share her culture, her humour and her references.
aboutPage.founderP2: The city has no shortage of places to go — cafés, gyms, restaurants. What was missing was an easy way to actually meet someone. She started with small meetups; very quickly, requests outnumbered the seats available.
aboutPage.founderP3: While looking for her own place, she created one where everyone can find theirs. The Host Club carries that idea forward.
aboutPage.value1: Your name at your seat, a personal welcome, introductions: nobody is left on their own.
aboutPage.value2: Carefully curated groups that never get too big: the community grows naturally rather than just bigger.
aboutPage.value3: Dinner, brunch, workshop or simply conversation: each gathering starts from a venue or a shared interest.
aboutPage.value4: A good gathering is one where you leave with someone you'll want to see again, outside our events.
